## Profile

M.S. Business Analytics & AI candidate with experience in statistical analysis, predictive modeling, data engineering, and analytical reporting. Proficient in Python, R, and SQL, with applied experience in hypothesis testing, consumer behavior analysis, KPI development, and data visualization.
